purpose: Authoritative consolidated backlog for the first 42 municipalities after retest, closure rounds, direct Omgevingsplan sweeps and final publication/form checks. Generic research-complete municipalities are not kept as vague open research defects; only legitimate property/dynamic/future-law follow-up remains.

qualityDefinitions.genericResearchComplete: Current generic legal/policy/application framework has been researched through the mandatory final sweep; any remaining item is address/location, dynamic form/Omgevingsloket, case-specific or an explicit future-law watch.
qualityDefinitions.avoidableOpenEnd: A non-address-specific legal/application question that could still reasonably be answered by another official-source search.
qualityDefinitions.target: zero avoidable open ends before batch closure

researchCoverage.importantCaveat: 100% refers to generic research coverage under the defined standard, not to a claim that every possible property can be decided without an address or live Omgevingsloket/form interaction.
